messages:
alex: Heads-up — after last night's maintenance in us-west we saw a lot of short GPU OOM flares that triggered paging. Need to tune so we don't wake people for 10s blips.

maria: saw that in grafana, a cluster of nodes flapped for ~20-40s each. alerts said "gpu_node_unavailable" and paged.

cheng: can you paste the alert rule? maybe it lacks a 'for' clause.

alex: here's the rule we used:
```yaml
- alert: GPUNodeDown
  expr: kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status!="true",region="us-west-2"} > 0
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Node not Ready"
```
No 'for' on it.

sam: yeah add `for: 3m` and also group by node pool / failure_type. short flaps shouldn't page.

maria: grafana alerting fyi uses eval_interval 1m so 'for: 3m' should debounce 3 evals.

cheng: also suggest changing severity to ticket for low-cardinality, page only when cardinality>3 or sustained across AZs.

alex: how do we implement cardinality gating in PromQL? example?

cheng: something like:
```promql
count_over_time((kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status!="true"})[5m:])
```
or use `count by (zone)` and then `> 2` for pages.

sam: another pattern: use recording rule that tracks sustained_unready_nodes = sum_over_time(...) and then alert on that recording with `for`.

maria: Prop: Route alerts to ticket when `severity=ticket` or when `instance` cardinality <= 2. Use alertmanager route with `match_re`.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: alertmanager config updated in staging at 2165432400 by sam.

alex: nice — can we test with a synthetic spike job that cycles pods on 3 nodes for 2m? would that reproduce?

cheng: good call, add test harness in dev cluster. I'll spin it up.

sam: I'll prepare PR with rule changes + doc snippets about mute windows and grouping policy. Assign to @maria for review.

maria: ack, will review. Also add a grafana panel that shows raw flaps vs sustained events (p95 duration) so SREs can tune thresholds.

alex: TL;DR action items: 1) add for:3m to node alerts, 2) implement cardinality gating (count>2 -> page), 3) route low-card alerts to ticket, 4) test in dev with synthetic flaps, 5) add grafana panel. Owners: sam/cheng/maria. :thumbsup:

sam: will open PR and link here.

ops-bot: PR #872 opened by sam at 2165432580: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/872

maria: leaving a note to add SLO impact check: if ticketing causes regression in 99th latency, fallback to page.

alex: thanks all. I'll update oncall playbook doc after PR merges.
